{"dominantPattern":"Functional hepatobiliary and digestive burden compounded by uneven autonomic tone","mainDriver":"Hepatic/biliary system","symptomFindingMap":["fatigue -> pancreatic and adrenal reflex fibre irregularity under sustained functional demand","insomnia -> irregular autonomic wreath unable to shift into parasympathetic recovery, reinforced by lower-arc tension","bloating after meals -> sluggish bile flow combined with dark absorption ring and reduced colonic motility tone","constipation -> wreath displacement in colon territory indicating reduced motility tone","chronic stress -> uneven autonomic wreath reflecting reduced capacity to downshift from sympathetic activation"],"systemVerdicts":{"section_2_emotional_field":{"verdict":"needs-action","clue":"Work the Solar Plexus Chakra and the emotion of confident self-assertion and release of over-sensitivity, tied to internalized tension settling into the digestive and hepatic territory","findings":["irregular autonomic wreath consistent with difficulty settling into parasympathetic baseline","heavier pigment load in lower hepatic-adjacent arcs reflects internally held rather than discharged tension","diminished capacity for self-assertion with inward absorption of frustration","this internal compounding plausibly worsens bloating and fatigue"]},
    "section_3_cognitive_nervous":{"verdict":"needs-action","clue":"Uneven autonomic wreath tone, tighter in the lower arc governing intestinal and pelvic innervation","findings":["wreath tighter in lower arc (intestinal/pelvic) and looser in upper arc (cranial/sensory) indicating uneven autonomic distribution","restricted local blood and nerve supply in the tighter lower arc plausibly contributing to insomnia","pattern consistent with reduced capacity to shift from sympathetic activation to parasympathetic recovery","no structural degeneration evident; fibre architecture around wreath largely intact","digestive bloating and lower-arc wreath compression reinforce a gut-brain axis interpretation"]},
    "section_4_immune_lymphatic":{"verdict":"needs-action","clue":"Immune/mucosal resilience along the gut lining, downstream of autonomic wreath tension rather than an independent lymphatic finding","findings":["no strongly reactive lymphatic rosary pattern at outer ciliary rim","wreath tension suggests immune reading follows autonomic load rather than standing independently sound","tendency toward reduced mucosal resilience without overt lymphatic congestion markers","no scurf rim or dense lymphatic rosary identified at limbus in either eye"]},
    "section_5_endocrine_hormonal":{"verdict":"needs-action","clue":"Pancreatic reflex points (2 o'clock right iris, 10 o'clock left iris) and adrenal collarette points (6 o'clock both irides)","findings":["mild fibre irregularity at pancreatic reflex points suggesting reduced metabolic regulatory efficiency","no sharply reactive white marking at adrenal points, arguing against acute adrenal crisis","mild adrenal fibre irregularity consistent with sustained functional demand on adrenal regulation","consistent fibre-tone pattern across pancreatic and adrenal points supports a functional reading"]},
    "section_6_circulatory_cardiorespiratory":{"verdict":"fine","clue":"Cardiopulmonary territories (right 9-10 o'clock, left 2-3 o'clock)","findings":["no marked structural sign at cardiopulmonary territories","fibre tone reasonably even, no sodium ring, cholesterol ring, or arcus senilis at superior periphery","no cardiovascular or respiratory symptoms reported, consistent with iris findings","mild reduced regulatory evenness from the autonomic wreath cannot be entirely excluded but not elevated beyond a passive note"]},
    "section_7_hepatic":{"verdict":"needs-action","clue":"Amber-to-yellow-brown pigment overlay through right 7:30-8:30 o'clock hepatic territory and mirrored posterior liver reflex near left 8 o'clock","findings":["diffuse bilateral pigment overlay supporting a functional hepatic filtering burden with sluggish bile flow","reduced bile flow plausibly contributing to fermentation and gas formation downstream","fibre structure beneath pigment remains intact, favouring functional rather than structural reading","bilateral consistency of pigment overlay strengthens confidence hepatic/biliary output is a dominant burden","slowed hepatic flow places compensatory demand on kidneys and intestines"]},

    "section_9_renal_urinary":{"verdict":"fine","clue":"Renal territory at approximately 5:30 to 6:45 o'clock in both irides","findings":["no open lacuna or strong pigment deposit in renal territory","fibre tone reasonably preserved, arguing against primary renal structural burden","kidneys likely carrying increased secondary elimination demand from hepatic load","adequate structural reserve present to meet that added demand","no urinary or reproductive symptoms reported, no finding in uterus/ovary/bladder collarette reflex points"]},
